limitations: CPU reference uses python-chess geometry/legality and the shared expected Chen hash formula; it is independent of the native emitter but not an independently proved chess oracle.
Forward/backward finite gradients on width8 steps2 is a mechanics check, not learned quality.
Runtime failure after preflight may partially write; discard snapshot.
Native C has no per-call device allocation; Torch wrapper allocates owned output tensors and synchronizes.
Serial edge assembly, padding initialization and per-call pointer admission have not been optimized.
HIP7.2.4 compiler/Torch ROCm7.0 provider combination tested only for these fixtures.
